hadith:
Actions while Praying - Narrated `Uqba bin Al-Harith:

I offered the `Asr prayer with the Prophet (ﷺ) and after finishing the prayer with Taslim he got up quickly and went to some of his wives and then came out. He noticed the signs of astonishment on the faces of the people caused by his speed. He then said, "I remembered while I was in my prayer that a piece of gold was Lying in my house and I disliked that it should remain with us throughout the night, and so I have ordered it to be distributed."
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Maajid - الْمَاجِدُ - The Glorious

The name Al Maajid emphasizes the glory and majesty of Allah. It highlights His honor and the reverence He commands in the hearts of believers. The origin of this name comes from the Arabic root related to honor and magnificence, reflecting the Islamic belief in Allah's supremacy and grandeur in all aspects of existence.
verse:
Al-Ma'un - The Small kindnesses - 107:2-3

That is the one who repulses the orphan, and does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
